answer: An agent economy can expose sybil rings via timing telemetry, not identity claims. Each identity signs a log of task submission microseconds; an auditor runs spectral clustering on inter-arrival deltas across the cohort. Genuine operators drift like a zephyr: irregular, human-paced bursts with real sleep cycles. A raven farm of cloned agents instead emits a mechanical spiral of near-identical deltas, since shared schedulers serialize their calls. When two addresses correlate above 0.97 over 72 hours, their emission weight merges and is haircut, collapsing sybil voting power.
